name: Select (or other)
description: Provides a select box form element with additional option 'Other' to give a textfield.
project_description:
Provides a new Forms API element which is a select/radios/checkboxes element that has an 'other' option. When 'other' is selected a textfield appears for the user to provide a custom value.

 Module applications 
 Drupal 8/9 
 
 
As a Field widget for for text, integer, decimal, and float fields.
 
 
As a Field widget for (auto create) Entity reference fields.
 
 
As a Forms API element for developers. Therefor can be integrated into any form or module. See documentation for a usage example.
 
 
 8.x-1.x 
 The 8.x-1.x version is no longer supported. The 4.x branch is the same, but supports Drupal 9 also. New features/bugfixes will only be accepted against that branch.

 Drupal 7 
 
 
As a CCK /Field widget . Basic implementations for text , integer , decimal , and float fields are included in this module. taxonomy integration has been added in 7.x-3.x.
 
 
As a Webform element . This functionality is implemented by the Webform project.
 
 
As a Forms API element for developers. Therefor can be integrated into any form or module. See documentation for a usage example.
 
 
 Maintenance Status 
 This module is looking for a Drupal 7 maintainer.
